outline: 訓練學生基本實驗技巧，探討理論，認識儀器，對實驗結果之數據與現象做評析與處理，有基本寫技術性報告之能力。
schedule:
週次 week	實 驗 進 度 experiments
1一		實驗內容講解、實驗課規定、安全衛生教育 explain lab rules and lab safety, quiz will be given, must attend
2二		補假
3三		實驗一：三成份系之液液平衡 Three-component liquid-liquid balance
4四		實驗二：乙酸乙酯的水解反應－一級反應Hydrolysis of ethyl acetate-first order reaction
5五	        實驗三：乙酸乙酯的皂化反應－二級反應Saponification reaction of ethyl acetate-secondary reaction
6六	        實驗四：電位分析法－氧化還原滴定Potentiometric Analysis-Redox Titration
7七	        補假
8八		實驗五：導電度的測定Determination of electrical conductivity
9九	        實驗六：pH值與兩性電解質的解離度pH value and dissociation degree of ampholyte
10十	        實驗七：分解電壓之測定Determination of the decomposition voltage
11十一	實驗八：溶液中的吸附Adsorption in solution
12十二	實驗九：折射率的測定Determination of Refractive Index
13十三	實驗十：聚合物分子量測定 Determine polymer molecular weight
14十四	打掃實驗室 cleaning
15十五	整理實驗室器材 reorganize lab equipment
16十六        盤點實驗室藥品 survey chemicals
17十七         放假(期末複習)
18十八         期末考 final
assessment:
10次報告成績: 預報2分, 結報8分
當次沒有來做實驗就沒有當次分數，不補做。
for each experiment, everyone will turn in a preparation report, which counts 2 points, each group will turn in a summary report a week later, which counts 8 points.
your final grade will be the sum of your 10 (preparation report+summary report)
there is no make-up for missing experiments, please show up on time
